in_marathi.name: Gangadev
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of the Ganga River
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gangadev हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Gangadev is the deity of the Ganga river, revered in Hindu mythology for his association with the river goddess Ganga. He is believed to purify the soul and bestow prosperity and good fortune upon devotees.
